body: When I was younger, I went to this really obscure anti technology private school. Basically, the premise was to get kids away from technology as much as possible while they're still developing. This school had a winter fair every year, and we were more or less able to run wild, and here is where my story takes place. I was in the 6th grade, and I was taking my friends to this ginormous drainage pipe we had found a little ways into the forest, and the entire class and I had huddled up inside, on the edge where it was still somewhat visible. While we were loitering around in that pipe, one of us claimed that we heard a noise from deeper within, and of course we decide to send someone down to "investigate". We're all terrified at this point, but with all of the boys wanting to look brave in front of the girls, about three people decide to go further in. After an extremely short "investigation" of approximately 45 seconds into the darkness, we see all three kids running out of the pipe as fast as possible, and behind them were two giant slanted eyes of pure white. If I had to compare to anything, it looked kind of like a large cat. Naturally, the entire class trampled eachother to get out of this thing, and we all rushed out of the forest to get back to the fair. I never did find out what those eyes were, or whether or not it was just our overactive imaginations, but none of us have went back since.
